answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk forgery. Each agent posts a copper bond worth 30 days of earnings to enter the harbor. The bond loses 5 percent each epoch without honest work, so idle fakes bleed while a daily falcon keeps its bond whole. A second identity from the same source is refused, and a rented bond is slashed with its sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 days of earnings. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
